# ECN-2026-018 Change notice - Machining radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01

Related documents: MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1, SOP-P2-L3-01, SOP-P2-L3-05

## Reason for change

Background: During a routine maintenance review and after an incident that produced excessive runout on a finished ring, the maintenance and reliability teams performed a focused investigation of the mandrel clamp assembly on EQ-P2-L3-RR01. The existing maintenance documentation referenced in MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 lacked a mandatory, documented clamp bolt torque value for the mandrel clamp. Field verification found inconsistent clamp bolt tensioning practices among technicians, which contributed to clamp slippage and repeat set-up adjustments during machining.

Engineering assessment determined that establishing a single validated clamp bolt torque will reduce clamp slippage, improve concentricity on first-pass machining, and reduce rework. The new torque value is also required to align SOP practice language between SOP-P2-L3-01 and SOP-P2-L3-05 and to provide clear acceptance criteria for maintenance and operations crews.

Change objective: Issue a controlled change to maintenance and operating procedures to mandate the verified mandrel clamp bolt torque for EQ-P2-L3-RR01 to ensure consistent clamp preload, reduce part rejects, and improve process capability.

Mandated value: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 470 N·m.

## Affected items

Scope: This change affects the mandrel clamp assembly and associated fasteners on EQ-P2-L3-RR01 and all work instructions, maintenance checklists, and operator setup procedures that reference clamp torque for that equipment.

Documents to be revised:
- MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 — update maintenance procedure section to include the mandated torque and acceptance criteria.
- SOP-P2-L3-01 — update machine setup steps to require verification of clamp torque prior to cut.
- SOP-P2-L3-05 — update maintenance verification and handover criteria to include post-torque inspection and recordkeeping.

Affected personnel and roles:
- Maintenance technicians assigned to EQ-P2-L3-RR01 must apply the mandated torque and document the action in the maintenance record.
- Machine operators must verify presence of the maintenance record before commencing production and confirm clamp integrity as specified in SOP revisions.
- Reliability engineers will monitor clamp-related defects and trend results after implementation.

Excluded items:
- Other radial ring rolling mills and other clamps not explicitly identified as part of EQ-P2-L3-RR01 are not included in this ECN; any adoption on other equipment requires separate ECN and validation.

## Implementation

Procedure updates: The maintenance procedure in MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 will be revised to add a dedicated step for mandrel clamp bolt torque. The step will identify the required torque value, acceptable evidence of torque application, and acceptance checks for clamp seating and thread engagement. SOP-P2-L3-01 and SOP-P2-L3-05 will be updated to reference the revised maintenance document and to require verification of the maintenance entry prior to machine start.

Work instruction excerpt (for insertion into MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 and SOPs):
- Clean clamp bolt threads and seating area; inspect for damage or contamination.
- Apply specified torque to clamp bolts using a calibrated torque wrench.
- The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 470 N·m.
- Record torque application in the equipment maintenance log with technician initials and torque wrench serial number.
- Perform visual check for proper clamp seating and confirm no gap exists between clamp face and mandrel flange.

Tools and calibration: Only calibrated torque wrenches with valid calibration tags are to be used. Calibration records will be checked during the first implementation audit.

Training and competence: Conduct focused training for affected maintenance technicians and operators covering the change rationale, the new mandatory torque value, correct torque application technique, and record requirements. Training attendance and competence checks will be documented.

Implementation steps and timeline: The revised documents will be issued as controlled revisions and distributed through document control. Maintenance for EQ-P2-L3-RR01 will incorporate the new step at the next scheduled downtime window. During the first applications after implementation, a reliability engineer will perform a verification of clamp torque and seating.

Examples of acceptable records:
- Maintenance log entry that states the torque value applied, technician initials, date, and torque wrench identifier.
- Post-maintenance checklist item in SOP-P2-L3-05 confirming torque verification and clamp inspection.
- A photo of the clamp with visible seating and torque wrench in-station where applicable.

Monitoring and metrics: Reliability will track clamp-related defects and first-pass machining yield for EQ-P2-L3-RR01 after implementation. Trend analysis will reference the maintenance records and SOP signoffs. If clamp slippage or related defects persist, further engineering evaluation and possible hardware redesign will be initiated.

Document control actions: MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1, SOP-P2-L3-01, and SOP-P2-L3-05 will receive revision updates citing ECN-2026-018. The controlled copies on the plant network will be updated and superseded copies archived per document control policy.

## Approvals

Required approvals:
- Maintenance Manager: approves update to MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 and confirms technicians will be trained.
- Operations Manager: approves SOP updates and confirms operator verification requirement.
- Reliability Engineer: approves the torque validation method and will monitor post-implementation results.
- Document Control: issues controlled revisions and records the ECN in the change log.

Approval records to be kept:
- Signed ECN approval sheet archived in the document control system.
- Revision history entries in MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1, SOP-P2-L3-01, and SOP-P2-L3-05 referencing ECN-2026-018.
- Training rosters and competency checklists showing attendance and successful demonstration.
- Calibration certificates for torque wrenches used, linked to maintenance log entries.
- Maintenance log entries and photographic evidence where applicable.

References: MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1, SOP-P2-L3-01, SOP-P2-L3-05

Change owner: Maintenance Engineering lead for line P2-L3

Document distribution: Controlled electronic copies will be issued to maintenance, operations, reliability, and document control. Physical copies will be posted at the EQ-P2-L3-RR01 maintenance station as referenced in the revised SOPs.
